title: A native error in the Windows capture-job observe_member permanently loses a witness and keeps the job and root forever
outcome: When observe_member fails after a NEW_PROCESS message has been consumed, the lost witness is recorded explicitly, so the retained drainer can report it and stop waiting forever, while custody still fails safe.
acceptance: a lost witness after a consumed NEW_PROCESS message is recorded and reported
a regression injecting an OpenProcess or IsProcessInJob failure shows the drainer does not wait forever on a witness that can never arrive, and never releases the root early
